main_text.l: XI. Synodus Romana, sub Damaso Episcopo Romano, adversus haereses Apollinaris, Timothei, & sectatorum, indicta A.C. CCCLXXIII. Valentiniani, x. (ut Baronius ad eundem annum T. iv. Annal. Eccles.) sancivit numerum Canonicorum, & Paulinis Epistolis accensuit tnam[?] ad Hebraeos. Cujus licet Synodi Acta penitus interciderint, hinc inde ex fragmentis nonnulla restituta. De hoc Canone alibi Baronius ad A.C. LX. num. LIII. item ad A.C. CCCCV. num. LXIII.

XII. Faustinus, Presbyter Romanus, clarus sub Valentiniano & Theodosio, Libro de fide contra Arianos ad Flaccillam, Cap. iv. adducturus locum Hebr. 1. 5. Ad quem Angelorum dixit &c. utitur his verbis, Paulus Apostolus ait in Epistola sua. Ita locis passim aliis Epistolam sub Pauli Apostoli nomine citat.
XIII. Ambrosius, Mediolanensis Episcopus, magni & excelsi vir animi, natus sub Constantino Magno, denatus sub Theodosio, quarto nondum expirante sa-[?]

page.notes: Line "accensuit tnam" at the line end is uncertain: the word broken between "accensuit" and "ad Hebraeos" is read as "etiam" in an abbreviated form and is marked [?]. The last word "sa-" at the foot of the page is an uncertain fragment, read as "sa-" with [?]; it is a broken word carried over, not a catchword. No catchword or signature is printed.
